title: eval: add prompt-set regression checks and CI gating for eval-harness
author: Asha Patel
description: Add automated prompt-set regression checks to the eval-harness and wire them into CI as a quality gate. Motivation: we have seen several regressions where small prompt or model changes caused measurable quality degradation for key prompt sets (see ENG-4123). This PR introduces a lightweight comparator that runs historical baseline metrics for configured prompt-sets, fails CI when regression exceeds thresholds, and provides a summarized HTML/JSON artifact for triage. Changes include: (1) a new eval runner module that computes per-metric deltas and applies thresholds, (2) YAML CI job templates to run the eval suite on PRs and release branches with configurable time budgets, (3) unit and integration tests for the comparator logic, and (4) documentation and a short troubleshooting guide. Checklist: - [x] implement comparator and threshold config - [x] add CI job and artifact publishing - [x] add tests and fixtures - [x] update docs and quickstart - [x] smoke test on internal release branch How it works: The comparator accepts a current-run metrics JSON and a stored baseline JSON (s3/artifact cache). For each configured prompt-set we compute delta for primary metrics (exact-match, f1, rouge-L, and a composite quality score). If any metric delta exceeds the configured regression threshold for that prompt-set, the comparator returns a non-zero exit code causing the CI job to fail and posting the artifact link to the PR. The CI job is gated behind a new "eval-gate" check which can be disabled for special release windows. Implementation notes: - Baseline storage is pluggable; default implemented using the existing artifacts bucket + date-tagged keys. - Thresholds are stored alongside prompt-set metadata in eval-harness/prompt_sets/*.yaml and can be overridden via PR labels. - To avoid flakiness, runs are sampled to a fixed random seed and use deterministic model-checking mocks in unit tests. Rollout plan: feature branch protected behind flake-free unit tests, short dogfood on internal/release-qa for two weeks, then enable for all PRs targeting main. Related items: ENG-4123, QA-1092.

release_notes: Introduce prompt-set regression checks and CI eval-gate: adds comparator, per-prompt-set thresholds, CI gating workflow, and documentation. This enables automatic quality regression detection for configured prompt sets. Non-breaking; feature gated.
notes_for_changelog: Add eval-gate workflow and comparator to detect prompt-set regressions; configurable thresholds per prompt-set; artifacts published for triage.
testing_and_validation: Unit and integration tests added, fixtures added for deterministic runs. Manual dogfood on internal/release-qa branch for 3 days. Observability: artifacts contain per-metric deltas and histograms to aid triage.
risk_and_mitigation: False positives are mitigated with per-prompt-set thresholds and a short grace window. Feature gate allows roll-back. Baseline updates require explicit publish to avoid accidental overwrites.
backport_notes: No backport required. If needed, cherry-pick comparator and CI job into release/* branches and update thresholds accordingly.
analytics_and_metrics: Outputs include per-prompt-set deltas for exact-match, f1, rouge-L, and composite score. CI artifacts are stored for 30 days. Alerting hooks can be added later to post regressions to Slack/Linear.
